dremio-mcp.note: Cross-platform local Dremio MCP server for a Dremio cluster or Dremio Cloud project. Requires uvx in PATH plus DREMIOAI_DREMIO__URI and DREMIOAI_DREMIO__PAT in the environment that starts the agent; DREMIOAI_DREMIO__URI should include https:// and the port for self-managed clusters, for example https://dremio.example.com:443. Set DREMIOAI_DREMIO__PROJECT_ID for Dremio Cloud projects. The plugin sets no DREMIOAI_* defaults, so values from the launching environment always apply. See docs/config.md.
